title: Voice: one assistant places each sentence as you talk

chat.text: One plain voice assistant replaces the fast assistant. Each Whisper sentence lands in place in the chat bubble, and the assistant places it: same paragraph (default), its own paragraph, or its own card. Plan first at /framework/ux/Dictate/doc/voice-assistant.md, then the smallest working slice.
